patch.value: GH-790/GH-791: pm merge install reports workspace_root in a different canonical form depending on which channel resolved it, so the same repository has two non-equal spellings on macOS and Windows

Nightly Validation is red on macos-latest/Node 24 (GH-790) and windows-latest/Node 24 (GH-791) at commit d885d5a0. Both legs fail tests/unit/sdk/merge-safety.spec.ts:1356 'uses protected source coordinates as a fallback while explicit tracker paths win', and the assertion diff names the defect exactly:

  macOS   expected /var/folders/8j/.../pm-merge-linked-sandbox-UQBR2y
          received /private/var/folders/8j/.../pm-merge-linked-sandbox-UQBR2y
  Windows expected C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\pm-merge-linked-sandbox-HaDoa0
          received C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\pm-merge-linked-sandbox-HaDoa0

The result field is not stable across resolution channels. When PM_SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT supplies the root, or when cwd discovery does, workspace_root is returned as given. When an explicit tracker path is passed, the root is derived through findGitWorkspaceRoot (src/sdk/merge/install.ts:139-142), which runs git rev-parse --show-toplevel and then realpath()s the result - so that channel alone returns the canonical spelling. On Linux the two spellings coincide and the divergence is invisible; on macOS (/var symlinked to /private/var) and Windows (8.3 short names vs long names) they do not.

This is a product defect, not a spec defect, and it must not be repaired by normalizing the expectation in the spec. The same reasoning applied to pm-0fhw: a caller that passes a tracker path and then compares the returned workspace_root against its own path gets a false negative on two of three supported platforms. installMergeSafety already canonicalizes internally at src/sdk/merge/install.ts:604-605 for the containment check, with a comment explaining precisely this Windows short-path hazard - so the containment logic is correct and only the reported coordinate leaks the inconsistency. The fix is to decide one canonical form for the reported coordinates and apply it on every channel, then state it in the MergeInstallResult docstring so SDK consumers can compare safely.

Same class as pm-0fhw (realpath fallback asymmetry in extension-install copy), different production site.

workspace_root and pm_root in the MergeInstallResult carry one documented canonical form for every resolution channel (explicit tracker path, PM_SOURCE_* env, cwd discovery), and the macOS and Windows nightly legs pass tests/unit/sdk/merge-safety.spec.ts without per-platform normalization in the spec
